AI Chip Market Share Analysis Report 2025

Market Overview:
- Global AI chip market size reached $48 billion in 2025, a year-over-year increase of 65%.
- Data centers are the largest application scenario, accounting for approximately 65%.

Vendor Market Share (2025 Q1):
- NVIDIA: 72.5% (H100, H200, Blackwell series)
- AMD: 8.2% (MI300X series)
- Intel: 6.8% (Gaudi2, Gaudi3)
- Google: 5.1% (TPU v5, TPU v6)
- Others: 7.4% (Vendor self-developed chips)

Product Type Distribution:
- GPU Accelerators: 78.3% (Main for training and inference)
- ASIC Chips: 15.6% (Google TPU, AWS Inferentia)
- FPGA: 4.2% (Low latency scenarios)
- Others: 1.9%

Regional Markets:
- North America: 48.5%
- China: 31.2%
- Europe: 12.8%
- Other Regions: 7.5%

Development Trends:
1. Self-developed chips accelerating.
2. Edge AI growth (on-device AI chips for mobile phones and automobiles).
3. Energy efficiency optimization (green computing).
4. Computing-in-memory architectures commercializing.

Future Outlook:
- Market size expected to exceed $80 billion in 2026.
- Annual growth rate remaining above 50%.
- Chinese vendors expected to gain market share due to indigenous innovation policies.
